topic: Is Selunara free to use as the product name of a Windows desktop AI coding assistant (formerly MoonAliza/Moonzila; Selenic was refused for a Parasoft trademark): US, EU and WIPO marks for Selunara and close variants; software and AI products and companies named Selunara; GitHub, npm and PyPI names; selunara domains; Microsoft Store listings; the word's meaning
notes: Run 1: 16 owning pages and search endpoints named directly, no queries (maxScrapes 16, about 16 credits). Budget 20 credits for the whole project; phase 0 ran as a dry run and spent nothing (doctor balance 326 before any fetch), so run 1 leaves about 4 for one follow-up run: TSDR records for any Justia hit in software classes, the site of any product the web search shows, and the .dev, .app and .io lookups. URL provenance: the endpoint shapes come from the sibling projects' plans (docs/research/2026-10-12-selenic-name-check/research/plan*.json and docs/research/2026-10-12-product-name-screen/research/plan*.json), which record which ones rendered; the RDAP servers from the IANA RDAP bootstrap file (data.iana.org/rdap/dns.json), read during planning. Planning curls and DNS lookups on 2026-10-12 (status codes and address records only, not evidence) chose 200-answering endpoints for every absence: the npm package document and the PyPI JSON for selunara answer 404, and so do the RDAP records for selunara.dev, selunara.app and selunara.io; selunara.ai's RDAP answers 200 and its www name points at a Namecheap parking host; selunara.com has no address record. Not attempted: tmsearch.uspto.gov, TMview and the WIPO Global Brand Database (U-03, U-04; the sibling project showed this transport cannot read them).
